method: Deterministic batch D: sorted unresolved family names with index % 3 == 0. Only official organizer pages and regulations were used. Organizer-published 2026/27 data is stored directly; dates from 2025/26 are marked previous_year_estimate and retain their source-season dates for later projection by the catalog builder. Profile-specific schedules are attached by slug so a family-level value cannot erase real profile differences.
